iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised as soon as a user has logged in successfully.

Examples
	when ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN {
	    log local0. "Username [ANTIFRAUD::username] has logged in successfully."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0
	       --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
